notes.title: Update 1.2!
notes.content:
One month after the release of Simple Racing, we are happy to finally bring new features and content! Patch notes:
- Wet weather races, brand new and exciting racing with your friends or against AI, races in tricky weather always creating unpredictable situations. Even the smallest mistake can prove costly so one has to be precise to be successful in the wet!

Also added:
- Ability to choose race track or join a random online lobby

Bug Fixes
- Fixed a bug where AI positions in name tags wouldn't show up
- Fixed a bug where track name was incorrectly shown in statistics

Stay tuned for update 1.3 which will bring a brand new Championship Mode!

notes.title: Week 1 Patch, Update 1.1!
notes.content:
Not four days has passed since the initial release of Simple Racing and here I am bringing you some small fixes and updates that you asked for; Update 1.1:

- Fixed AI brake lights
- Enabled the option to turn off the racing line
- Fixed a bug where the graphics resolution and settings would reset after a race

Stay tuned for an actual update with new content like car customization's and AI settings!
